text:
maria: Heads up — CloudSmith rotated their marketplace webhook auth key last night without telling us. We missed ~6h of usage files from eu-west-1. Billing flagged gaps. cc @sam @lee

sam: saw the billing alerts earlier. rough estimate ~45k tokens missing across 3 enterprise customers. can we pull raw failed webhooks?

lee: I dug into the gateway logs — signature validation started failing at 03:12 UTC. we returned 401 on their webhook retries. example log: 

```
POST /hooks/usage 401
headers:
  X-CS-Signature: sha256=abcd1234... (new key)
Body: {"customer_id":"acct_123","usage":[{"ts":1728500000,"tokens":15000}],"event_id":"evt_987"}
```

clara: i'm on a call with their PM. they rotated keys in their portal at ~02:50 UTC as part of a routine rotation and didn't update the webhook creds here. they realize and are ready to resend.

maria: OK — immediate plan: 1) accept both old+new signatures for a limited window so incoming retries succeed, 2) ask CloudSmith to resend failed events (compressed), 3) run backfill + reconciliation for impacted customers. Sam + Lee + Alex own pieces.

lee: can implement dual-key validation and a backfill acceptor. estimate ~2h to push a toggle + 1h for backfill worker. need a tiny schema change to store partner_key_version on partner records. i'll open ENG PR and tag it ENG-812.

alex: ops note — if we accept two keys we need to refresh our in-memory cache and ensure key TTLs don't cause a mismatch. i'll deploy cache clear once PR is live.

billing-bot: Alert: 3 customers at risk of negative deltas if backfill not applied — acct_123, acct_999, acct_888. Potential credit exposure flagged.

sam: creating tickets now: PART-457 (coordination/backfill), BILL-889 (reconciliation + credits), ENG-812 (dual-signature toggle). target: close by EOD. I'll draft the reconciliation spreadsheet with columns: customer, missing_token_count, invoice_window, proposed_credit_usd.

clara: CloudSmith said they'll resend failed webhooks for 03:00-09:00 UTC but they have rate limits — asked them to provide one compressed batch per customer in S3 signed URL.

lee: backfill plan: accept compressed payloads, validate event_id idempotency, and apply usage increments. acceptance rule snippet: `idempotency_key = partner_id + event_id`. we'll also log original delivery timestamp for audit.

maria: who will handle customer comms? product wants a short notice for impacted enterprise contacts. @sam?

sam: i'll draft a support/customer note: apologize, explain root cause (partner key rotation), list mitigation (we accepted retries + backfilled), and include credits if we can't fully reconcile. will ping CSMs directly for the 3 affected accounts.

maria: good. please post the comm to #support-digest and tag CSMs once ready. ping this thread when PR merges so we can flip the toggle. also copying legal for contract/SL implications.

alex: PR review + ops steps queued. i'll coordinate the deploy window after ENG-812 merges.

lee: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/eng/pulls/812 (description: dual signature validator + backfill worker). requesting quick review.

billing-bot: Update: preliminary reconciliation shows acct_123 missing 14,800 tokens, acct_999 missing 18,200 tokens, acct_888 missing 11,700 tokens.

sam: noted. i'll run numbers after backfill completes and determine credits.

maria: thanks team. goal: accept partner payloads within the hour, start backfill ingestion within 3 hours, reconcile and finalize credits by EOD. keep updates here — short one-liners are fine.

lee: will update when toggle is live.

clara: CloudSmith confirmed they uploaded compressed retry bundles and shared signed S3 URLs. linking in PART-457.

maria: perfect. closing loop later with a postmortem and recommended process change: partners must notify us before rotation and we should support key rotation handshake via provisioning API.

sam: agreed — add to partnership onboarding playbook.

maria: thanks, all.
